title: Common Architecture Language Model (CALM) Timelines Vocab
description: A timeline of an architecture: the moments at which it changed, each a node that points to the architecture of that moment.

current-moment.description: The unique-id of the current architecture moment within the timeline.

moments.description: A list of significant architecture states or points in time, each represented as a 'moment'.

node-moment.description: A moment of a timeline: a node of type moment, with no interfaces, whose details point to the architecture of that moment.

valid-from.description: The date when this architecture moment came into effect.

adrs.description: External links to ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) or similar documents that provide context or decisions related to why the architecture changed.

unique-id.description: The node's identifier, unique within the architecture.

node-type.description: What kind of node this is, one of CALM's built-in types or any other name.

description.description: What the node is and does.

details.description: Where a more detailed architecture of this node is, and the pattern it must follow.

detailed-architecture.description: The address of an architecture document that describes this node in detail.

required-pattern.description: The address of a pattern that the detailed architecture must follow.

controls.description: The controls that apply to this node.
